content: Hey Tina. What are you doing?
I was just watching TV. What's going on with you?
I just watched a movie and I'm scared.
I saw the Sixth Sense. I didn't know it was going to be so scary.
I remember that. It was a great movie. But it was definitely scary.
If you're not busy, do you want to come over? I'm afraid to be alone.
Sure. I can come over. What should we do?
How about if we watch a comedy. I need something to get my mind off the frightening images I have from the Sixth Sense.
Ok. I'll get ready and leave. I'll see you in about 20 minutes.
Don't worry, nothings going to happen. I'll be there real soon.
